evals.prompt: Review this FastAPI backend repository and prepare to update its README.md. Follow your skill workflow: inspect the codebase first, and if an existing README or missing critical info needs my decision before editing, ask me cleanly before overwriting anything.
evals.expected_output: Performs silent discovery on the Python/FastAPI/Docker repo first, detects the Backend API archetype, preserves awareness of the existing custom README and local diagram asset, presents a Diff & Upgrade Report table, identifies missing facts (no LICENSE file, undocumented REDIS_URL referenced in code), and pauses at Phase 2 (Collaborative Discovery & Scoping Gate) to ask about Scope, Audience, Highlights, and Update Strategy in a single consolidated turn with recommended defaults.
expectations: Identifies the repository as a Python FastAPI backend API service (without Node.js or npm assumptions).
Presents an Existing README Diff & Upgrade Report table (comparing valid custom sections vs stale commands/env) before proposing modifications.

Pauses at Phase 2 (Collaborative Discovery & Scoping Gate) and asks the user to scope out the README (Audience, Scope, Highlights, Update Strategy) using interactive multiple-choice with recommended defaults rather than unilaterally generating.
Flags the missing LICENSE file and the undocumented REDIS_URL referenced in app/config.py instead of fabricating a license or omitting the gap silently.
Does not leak or invent Node.js commands (e.g., npm run dev) or fake MIT license assumptions.
Consolidates open decisions/questions into a single clear turn (with recommended defaults) rather than splitting across multiple confirmation gates.

evals.prompt: Viết file README.md bằng tiếng Việt chuẩn cho repo monorepo này (kết hợp Go CLI và TypeScript core package) và lưu kết quả trực tiếp. Không cần hỏi xác nhận thêm vì đây là repo mới, dùng tiếng Việt và công khai theo LICENSE có sẵn.
evals.expected_output: Detects hybrid Monorepo + CLI + TypeScript package signals, honors non-interactive bypass from explicit instruction, generates a root README.md in natural diacritic Vietnamese (zero translationese or marketing buzzwords), uses Centered Hero Header with Quick Links bar if visual asset exists or clean GFM layout, applies anti-duplication by linking workspace packages and satellite files (LICENSE/CONTRIBUTING) instead of duplicating full text, documents verified Go CLI flags, includes grounded Mermaid workspace flow, and avoids Node/npm-only assumptions.
expectations: Writes the output README.md in natural Vietnamese with complete, accurate diacritics (no ASCII-stripped Vietnamese).
Identifies both workspace packages (packages/core TypeScript library and apps/cli Go CLI) and links to their directories instead of forcing a single-app template.
Applies anti-duplication rule: references LICENSE and CONTRIBUTING with concise single-line links rather than dumping full texts.
Includes a Quick Links bar and structured navigation matching the monorepo architecture.
Documents verified CLI flags (--format, --strict, --target) from apps/cli/main.go and verified root pnpm scripts without fabricating nonexistent commands.

Avoids banned Vietnamese translationese ('đóng vai trò như một', 'hoạt động như một', 'mang trong mình', 'nhằm mục đích') and marketing buzzwords ('mượt mà', 'cực nhanh', 'mạnh mẽ', 'linh hoạt', 'toàn diện').
Includes the verified MIT license from LICENSE and proceeds directly without unnecessarily blocking on confirmation when authorized.

evals.prompt: Create a README.md for this private Next.js + Firebase repository and save it directly without waiting for confirmation. Keep the README in English and strictly safe for a private codebase.
evals.expected_output: Creates a clean English README.md honoring non-interactive bypass, using ESL-accessible technical writing (WIIFM opening, active voice, no modifier stacking, Flesch-Kincaid <= Grade 9), proper GFM callouts (> [!NOTE], > [!TIP]), verified Next.js scripts and .env.example variable names while strictly excluding real secret values from .env, Firebase security rules from firestore.rules, raw database columns from prisma/schema.prisma, and CI workflow internals from .github/workflows/deploy.yml, and omitting any fabricated MIT/open-source License section.
expectations: Opens with a clear 1-2 sentence WIIFM statement explaining what the application does and its core workflow benefit.
Adheres to ESL technical readability (active voice, short noun phrases without modifier stacking, 1 concept per sentence, zero marketing fluff).
Uses standard GFM callouts (> [!NOTE], > [!TIP], > [!WARNING]) for configuration notes instead of decorative emojis.

Documents only safe environment variable names from .env.example (NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_API_KEY, DATABASE_URL, STRIPE_SECRET_KEY) and never exposes real secret values or internal webhook URLs from .env.
Does not leak Firebase security rules from firestore.rules.
Does not dump raw internal database columns from prisma/schema.prisma.
Does not expose CI/CD deployment internals from .github/workflows/deploy.yml.
Omits any fabricated open-source License section because package.json is marked private and no LICENSE file exists.
Uses only verified scripts from package.json (dev, build, lint) without inventing nonexistent scripts.
